surface.always_on_cap_reason: CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy loads the project memory file (CODEBUDDY.md) into every request, so the always-on text is paid on every turn
surface.trigger_hint: Skills are advertised by name+description; make the description name the situation.

stubs.body: <!-- c6: WorkBuddy runs the CodeBuddy CLI core, which reads user skills from <config dir>/skills (WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR, default ~/.workbuddy) and project skills from .codebuddy/skills; this tree's skills/ directory is installed to the staged config dir. YAML frontmatter needs `name:` matching the directory and `description:`. Helpers travel under the skill's own scripts/. -->
<!-- c7: deterministic helpers, run as `python3 scripts/<name>.py` from the workspace. -->
